Getting Started with Claude Code at SAP

Learning Journeys

What is this? SAP's CE³ team has released the Claude Code Automated Installer Bundle — a one-click setup that installs Claude Code and Cline on your machine. This is part of SAP's broader Agentic AI Enablement program, designed to help everyone from business innovators to engineers work faster with AI.

Who Is This For?

The installer works for three personas — no matter your technical background:

Business AI Innovator

Process & Product Leaders

Define value, shape MVPs. You don't code — but you can use AI to build decks, analyze feedback, draft proposals, and summarize meetings.

Citizen Developer

Domain Experts

You know the process. Build simple automations, workflows, and dashboards without writing production code.

AI Engineer

Builders

Ship code daily. Use the toolchain for faster development, automated testing, migrations, and code reviews.

What Can You Do With It?

Here are real scenarios from SAP teams — showing what used to take hours or days, now takes minutes:

Task Before With AI
Build a status deck from emails, sprint data, and last week's slides ~1.5 hours ~10 min
Analyze 3 Excel exports of customer feedback for themes ~3 hours ~15 min
Draft an MVP proposal from strategy docs ~1 week ~1 day
Compare 3 vendor proposals and write recommendation ~4 hours ~20 min
Build an expense approval workflow (>10K needs manager sign-off) ~2 days ~2 hours
Set up automated Friday Slack summary of Jira sprint status ~1 day ~1 hour
Migrate 30 CDS files from CAP v5 to v7 syntax ~1 day ~1 hour
Review a colleague's 800-line PR across 15 files ~2 hours ~20 min

💡 Key insight: The pattern isn't "AI writes everything." It's: drop your files, describe what you want, review the output. You stay in control — AI handles the grunt work.

How to Install

1

Access the CE³ Enablement Portal

Go to the CE³ Agentic AI Enablement Products page (internal SAP link). Find the "Claude Code Automated Installer Bundle" card.

2

Download the Installer for Your OS

Choose Windows or macOS. The bundle includes everything: Claude Code, Cline, and required dependencies.

3

Run the Script

Windows: Open PowerShell as Administrator, navigate to the download folder, run the installer script.

macOS: Open Terminal, navigate to the download folder, run chmod +x install.sh && ./install.sh

4

Authenticate

Follow the prompts to sign in with your SAP credentials. This connects you to the licensed API endpoints.

5

Start Using It

Open VS Code or your terminal. Try a simple task: "Summarize this document" or "Compare these two files."

✅ That's it. One script installs everything. No manual dependency management, no API key configuration, no waiting for IT tickets.
